articles.title: 2 Delhi MLAs among several injured after car jumps divider, slams into SUV
articles.description: An out-of-control car crashed through a divider at Delhi's ITO on Sunday evening. The vehicle then collided head-on with an SUV carrying two Members of the Legislative Assembly. Anil Jha and Abhay Patil sustained minor injuries in the accident near the PWD office. Both MLAs were promptly shifted to LNJP Hospital for medical observation. The collision caused significant damage and required the Fire Brigade's assistance.

articles.title: A businessman bought a 23,000-acre Scottish sporting estate and spent two decades rewilding it
articles.description: An ambitious English businessman has reimagined a historic Scottish hunting estate as a lush wilderness reserve. His initiative, which includes the planting of over one million native trees, has revived populations of red squirrels in the glens. The project also emphasizes the restoration of peatlands and the breeding of Scottish wildcats, with funding from upscale eco-tourism driving significant conservation efforts to protect and restore local ecosystems for the future.

Supported by local governments, this innovative project aims to enhance tourism while safeguarding natural ecosystems, with aspirations for international expansion in attracting marine life.

articles.title: A British couple bought a derelict 85-foot, seven-storey Victorian water tower at auction
articles.description: In Kennington, a neglected Victorian water tower dating back to 1877 has been transformed into a stunning family residence. This Grade II-listed landmark, originally built for an asylum, underwent a lavish restoration by a British couple. They incorporated a contemporary glass cube and an additional utility tower, resulting in a remarkable home boasting four bedrooms and panoramic views of the city.

articles.title: Oil prices slip over $1 as US weighs ‘D-Day’ Iran sanctions; Strait of Hormuz shipping risks in focus
articles.description: In the lead-up to impending US sanctions on Iran, oil prices fell as investors capitalized on recent gains. As Washington prepares to unveil its most stringent measures Monday, the potential for disruptions in Middle Eastern oil supply looms large. Iran's rejection of these sanctions, coupled with its threat to cut oil exports from the Gulf, adds a layer of uncertainty to global energy markets that stakeholders are closely monitoring.

articles.description: Colleges can now fill vacant seats after all Centralised Admission Process rounds conclude. articles.title: 'Batwara 1947' box office collection day 10: The film struggles to touch Rs 40 cr
articles.description: Batwara 1947's performance at the box office has been underwhelming following its release. Despite a promising start on Saturday, the film's earnings plummeted as the weekdays progressed, with only a minor boost seen on Tuesday. The second weekend didn't bring the revival it desperately needed, indicating a strong possibility of the movie being labeled a flop due to its poor trajectory.

articles.title: Ram Charan at Hyderabad after Chiranjeevi's birthday celebrations
articles.description: Ram Charan returned to Hyderabad after celebrating his father Chiranjeevi's birthday. He was seen with a bandage on his right hand following recent wrist surgery. Chiranjeevi celebrated his 71st birthday with wishes from industry stars. His upcoming movie 'Kaaka', directed by Bobby Kolli, was announced for a January 2027 release. The film is scheduled to arrive during the Sankranthi festive season.
